component.name: Docker Lite
component.summary: Ultra-fast, lightweight Docker desktop client and container studio

description.p: Docker Lite is a modern, resource-efficient container management studio built with Tauri v2, Rust, and React 19. Designed as a high-performance alternative to traditional Electron-based desktop clients, Docker Lite connects directly to your local Docker socket without running an extra virtualization layer, consuming only 30MB to 80MB of RAM.

ul.li: Continuous 1-second host hardware telemetry (CPU & RAM live area charts)
Instant container lifecycle control (start, stop, restart, pause, kill, commit, terminal exec)
Smart online image puller with Docker Hub search, auto-suggestions, and live layer progress
Targeted storage cleanup studio for images, volumes, build caches, and networks
Interactive network topology visualizer powered by XYFlow
1-click developer starter stacks for PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB, MySQL, RabbitMQ, Mailpit, and Nginx
Real-time engine event stream monitoring and streaming container logs
Eye-friendly OKLCH-calibrated Light and Dark themes
